name: Kimi K3 Fast

archDisplay: Same 2.8T-parameter Stable LatentMoE architecture as Kimi K3 (16 of 896 experts active per token, Kimi Delta Attention), served on a lower-latency inference stack
note: Fast-inference variant of Kimi K3, released the same day as K3's open-weight drop (July 27, 2026).
